title: Polyhedral convex AABB initialization
summary: Recovered the no-argument thiscall constructor body at VA 0x47bec0 as a readable member initializer. Preserves original 32-bit layout, vtable token, fixed floating-point defaults, return pointer and untouched bytes. Direct caller at 0x47cd72 replaces its vtable and initializes derived storage at +0x58.
test_description: Compare original thiscall reference and recovered member over 256 initial byte patterns, four MXCSR rounding modes, and repeated initialization. Independently assert all written bytes, returned this, untouched fields and padding, surrounding guards and unchanged MXCSR.
known_limits: Field names are inferred from the polyhedral convex AABB layout; unknown fields retain offset-based names.
The original vtable address is retained as a 32-bit token; dispatch table relocation and virtual methods are outside this bounded recovery.
Requires valid writable object storage; invalid pointers and concurrent access are outside the original contract.
Behavioral equivalence is tested; no matching-byte claim is made.
